description: Official lender payoff demand statement or cryptographically signed A2A payoff assertion establishing exact principal, accrued interest, per-diem accrual, good-through date, and closing wire routing instructions for an existing facility scheduled for retirement. Where to read: Identified by "Official Payoff Statement", "Payoff Demand", or structured A2A `loan-payoff-statement` assertions carrying a loan account reference, total payoff amount, and good-through date. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with a recurring monthly installment invoice, a preliminary credit agreement (`cre-credit-agreement`), or a final borrower closing statement (`trid-closing-disclosure`).

issuer.description: Existing commercial mortgage, equipment finance, or working-capital lender issuing an official payoff demand or structured A2A payoff assertion.

loan_account.description: Lender-assigned loan or facility account identifier being retired. Where to read: Header or Loan Account Reference row (e.g. #FNB-4402, #7712, #8841). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the ABA wire routing number or borrower tax ID.

payoff_amount.description: Total principal, accrued interest, and release fees required to retire the facility in full. Where to read: Total Official Payoff Amount row or structured payoff assertion. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the original loan commitment or a recurring monthly installment.

good_through_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) through which the stated payoff amount remains valid before additional per-diem interest accrues. Where to read: Payoff Quote Good Through clause or footer. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the original loan origination date.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. USD). Where to read: Payoff summary table or monetary unit indicator. Distinguish from: Normalize '$' to 'USD'.

borrower_name.description: Legal name of the borrowing entity obligated on the facility. Where to read: Borrower header block. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the issuing lender or administrative agent name.

per_diem_interest.description: Daily interest accrual amount charged after the good-through date. Where to read: Per-diem interest line item. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the annual interest rate percentage.

wire_routing_aba.description: 9-digit ABA routing number for closing Fedwire settlement. Where to read: Wire Instructions / Fedwire ABA block. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the loan account number.

wire_reference.description: Beneficiary wire reference or OBI memo confirming final payoff settlement. Where to read: Wire instructions or bank statement outgoing wire OBI/memo line. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract recurring monthly payment memos.

payoff_waiver_status.description: Underwriting payoff waiver status when reconciled against verified wire proof. Where to read: Derived or distilled cross-document settlement status. Distinguish from: Leave unset unless verified payoff wire proof is present.
